summary: A toggle for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label beside the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the setting.

description.note: Help text under the label; says what on and off mean.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: Current state (on). Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted; also set by a disabled ancestor fieldset.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, drawn as the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob that sits at the start when off and the end when on (mirrors in RTL). aria-hidden.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary; thumb moves to the end.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: ElementInternals: setFormValue(value) only while on, validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing), formResetCallback restores the default checked state, formDisabledCallback follows a disabled fieldset, disabled is not submitted.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20 (sm 24x16), below 24px tall in sm; the label is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). Toggling on Enter is optional in the APG and is not done here.

aria: role="switch" on the native input; aria-checked comes from the native checked state
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
state is never conveyed by color alone: the thumb position changes
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is either on or off and takes effect as soon as it changes
The on/off value must be submitted with a form
useCases.use: sb-switch with name (and value if not "on")

useCases.when: The consequence of on versus off needs explaining
A setting must be on before submit
useCases.use: required with a label that states it

antiPatterns.pattern: A yes/no choice that only applies after pressing Save
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as immediate; a recorded choice is a checkbox
A switch has two states only
A switch is a labelled form control, not a button

antiPatterns.pattern: Labels that flip with the state ("Enable" / "Disable")
antiPatterns.why: The label names the setting; the state is announced separately
antiPatterns.alternative: A stable label naming the setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn default off track is neutral-200; changed for WCAG 1.4.11
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern, label row beside the track.

openQuestions.question: Native input with role=switch, or a custom element with role=switch on a button?
openQuestions.answer: Native checkbox input with role=switch: free Space, validity and reset behavior, same architecture as Checkbox (SB-0007).

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No. The attribute is the default that form reset restores; checked is a property.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, like Checkbox and Input. hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle?
openQuestions.answer: No. Space toggles (Enter is optional in the APG); Enter does implicit form submission as in every form control (SB-0009).

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: default (32x20 track) and sm (24x16), through a size prop, using the existing size.switch tokens.

openQuestions.question: What does required mean?
openQuestions.answer: Must be on to submit: native valueMissing while off, error shown after blur or a submit attempt.

openQuestions.question: On/off icons or text inside the track?
openQuestions.answer: No. Thumb position and track fill carry the state; avoids localizing text and keeps the control small.

openQuestions.question: Off-track color: the lighter neutral or one that meets 3:1?
openQuestions.answer: color.input (3:1 against the background) for WCAG 1.4.11; listed as drift.
